flavor.phonemic_palette: near_eastern (akkadian: the alu/bit river-cities, the sangu temple-priesthood, the scribal ekallu, construct-chain toponyms, emphatic gutturals sh/q/kh/', triconsonantal roots, -u/-um endings, SOV agglutinative grammar, penultimate stress) / east_asian (sinitic: the walled cheng and the Mandate-of-Heaven bureaucracy, the mandarin officialdom, the silk and jade and tea trade, the river-junk and the canal, monosyllabic meaning-roots)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Huashinar — domineering imperial hegemony of the synthesis; law, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Huashinar are a vigorous imperial hegemony people, a first-order synthesis of Qinzhao and Shamhar [Peer Synthesis / Hegemonic]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field crossbowmen, heavy_infantry, heavy_cavalry. Outsiders are met as domineering; their patrons touch war.
